name: DellaDream🥩
text: Casper Fermentables in Austin TX has the best bagels I’ve ever had and I’ve lived in Brooklyn, Beverly Hills, Denver and Dallas/ had bagels in all. They are 4 ingredient sourdough milled in Barton Springs Tx. They don’t make me feel sick and ALL bread makes me feel sick.… pic.twitter.com/kMaVmoz1qM
